title: Logarithmic differential and factorial coefficient ideals
statement: Let $M=(Z,N,B,K,d)$ be a smooth marked datum over $\mathbf Q$ in the sense of [def-trf-hilbert-samuel-presentation], with its order from [def-trf-marked-ideal-order]. On an affine open $U\subset N$, let $D_B(I)$ be the sum of $I$ and the ideal generated by $\delta(f)$ for $f\in I$ and all $\mathbf Q$-derivations of $\mathcal O_N(U)$ preserving every labelled boundary ideal; this single step is the logarithmic derivative of [def-trf-marked-ideal-invariant-data]. Iterate this operation $j$ times, starting with $I$ at $j=0$, and form its quasi-coherent ideal from the compatible affine ideals. This is $D_B^jK$. Equivalently use $\mathbf Z$-derivations, since derivations on a rational algebra kill all rational scalars. Given a closed $i:H\hookrightarrow N$, define $C_{B,H}(K,d)=\sum_{j<d}((D_B^jK)\mathcal O_H)^{d!/(d-j)}$, with ideal operations as in [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Coefficient-restriction data require finite-type $Z,N$, an ordered SNC boundary transverse to $N$, a neighbourhood of cosupport on which $\operatorname{ord}K\le d$, a smooth hypersurface $H=V(h)$ transverse to $B$, $h\in D_B^{d-1}K$, and order one for $h$ at every point of $H$. Boundary transversality means the simultaneous etale-coordinate condition of [def-trf-etale-coordinate-flag], applied to the support twice. A marked realization of the coefficient ideal has support isomorphic over $Z$ to this specified $H$, ideal the transport of the displayed $C$, and mark $d!$. These are constructions and predicates, not an assertion of coherence, existence or test equivalence.
